items.name: Try /policies/refund-policy first
items.description: Open /policies/refund-policy before any other page; fall back to /pages/returns
items.text:
---
name: Try /policies/refund-policy first
description: Open /policies/refund-policy before any other page; fall back to /pages/returns
type: feedback
supersedes: [shopify-refund-policy-path.md]
---
Open `https://<shop>/policies/refund-policy` first. It answered at once on Taylor Stitch, Brooklinen and Allbirds.

**Why:** most of these shops run on Shopify, which always serves that path.

**How to apply:** fetch it before any search, every time.

items.name: Shopify refund policy path

items.text:
---
name: Shopify refund policy path
description: On a Shopify store the refund policy is at /policies/refund-policy
type: reference
status: superseded
superseded_by: try-policies-refund-policy-first.md
---
Shopify stores serve their refund policy at `/policies/refund-policy`.

`/pages/returns` and `/pages/refund-policy` were empty on Taylor Stitch: they hold a returns portal, not the policy.
